title: 卡蜜尔·钢影长廊
description: 银发卡蜜尔沿宽阔长廊行走后停步，完整高领衣装与机械刃足线条清晰，强侧光映出冷静轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Camille is an elegant older woman with a sharp silver bob, pale blue mechanical eyes, angular cheek details, and a precise upright bearing. Preserve her long dark high-collared coat and fully covering mechanical leg structure. Her distinctive elongated blade legs remain attached, grounded, and clearly articulated from the hips, with no raised kicking pose, exposed body panels, or weapon-like swing.
art_direction.scene: Show her pausing after a measured step on a broad uncluttered terrace, both mechanical feet in secure contact with the floor and hands held calmly behind her back. A strong sidelight defines long vertical wax-crayon planes on the coat. One distant bridge and receding clean columns emphasize depth, while the full silver-haired silhouette remains the clear focal point.
art_direction.palette: silver gray, midnight navy, ice blue, pale brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
